stage: ten-task exploratory screen; frozen before these model calls
model_revision_limit: provider alias; immutable serving revision and reproducible random seed unavailable
corpus: decision-corpus-v2 generated by prepare_decision_tasks.py; each runner records SHA-256
tools: deny all; each attempt fresh session; no filesystem or reports visible
retry: none in this static screen; provider failures are missing, preserve original and charge usage
presentation: D0 facts vs reversible columns preserves every fact, value, evidence ID and order
information: D1 adds per-case declared evidence; several negative controls already have enough D0 evidence
primary: field correctness and uncertainty calibration by task
recovery: For newly supplied source identity, workload or reference selection, correct unavailable in D0 is not an error. Report D1 information recovery separately from pass rate.
review: Exact/type checks are deterministic. Free-form mechanism, legality and experiment quality require explicit review; no hidden reasoning used.
selection: No bottom-layer deletion or wholesale directory change based on this screen. Consider only scoped defects or information with a demonstrated positive case; confirm on new cases before a default change.
stopping: Run the registered attempts once. Do not add repeats to chase a favorable comparison. Any follow-up is separately registered.
